serverConfig.title: Connect to Server
serverConfig.subtitle: Enter the address of your ObjectOS server.
serverConfig.label: Server URL

where.title: Where do I find the address?
where.step1: On a computer, open ObjectOS in your browser and sign in.
where.step2: Copy the address from the address bar. You can paste the whole link — the app keeps only the server part.

serverConfig.vpnHint: A server on a company network may need this phone to be on the company VPN first.

error.invalid: That doesn't look like a server address.
error.insecure: Use an https:// address — plain http is only allowed for local servers.
error.unreachable: Could not reach the server. Check the address and your network — a company server may need VPN.
error.tls: The server's certificate is invalid, so the connection isn't safe. Ask your administrator to fix it.
error.timeout: The server took too long to answer. Check your network or VPN and try again.
error.notObjectOS: This isn't an ObjectOS server. Use the address you open ObjectOS with in a browser.
error.serverError: The server answered with an error (HTTP {{status}}). Try again later or ask your administrator.
error.unknown: Something went wrong. Please try again.

managed.title: Set up by your organization
managed.checking: Checking the server your organization set up…
managed.locked: Your organization manages this app's server, so it can't be changed here.

shell.offlineMessage: Check your connection. The page reloads on its own when you're back online.
shell.serverErrorMessage: The server answered with error {{code}}. Try again in a moment.
shell.policyTitle: Can't show this page in the app
shell.policyMessage: The server's page keeps going to an address the app doesn't open. Try again, or switch organization.

excursion.signingIn: Signing in on an external page · {{server}}
excursion.redirects: The sign-in page redirected too many times. Try again, or ask your administrator.
excursion.timeout: Sign-in took longer than {{minutes}} minutes. Start again.
excursion.insecure: The sign-in page tried to continue over an insecure (http) connection, so it was stopped.
excursion.unsupported: This sign-in method isn't supported in the app yet. Choose another way to sign in.

switcher.title: Switch organization
switcher.add: Add an organization or company server
switcher.footnote: Each organization keeps its own sign-in. Swipe left to remove one and sign out of it.
switcher.lockedFootnote: Each organization keeps its own sign-in. {{label}} is set up by your organization and can't be removed.

scanner.hint: Place the QR code inside the frame
scanner.codeHint: Place the code inside the frame
scanner.connectNote: Contains only the server address, no account information
scanner.notConnectCode: This isn't a connect QR code

permission.title: Camera access needed
permission.body: Allow camera access to scan the QR code.
permission.blocked: Camera access is off for ObjectOS. Turn it on in Settings, or enter the address manually.
permission.codeBody: Allow camera access to scan the code.
permission.codeBlocked: Camera access is off for ObjectOS. Turn it on in Settings to scan codes.

permissions.camera: ObjectOS uses the camera to scan QR codes and barcodes, such as the code that connects it to your server.
